
## Download

1. Download **RAVE-LIVE.zip** below (under Assets).
2. Double-click it, then drag **RAVE LIVE.app** into your **Applications** folder.
3. Open RAVE LIVE. It isn't notarized by Apple, so macOS will say it can't verify the app. Click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to RAVE LIVE, then confirm. You only do this once.
4. Allow **Screen & System Audio Recording** when asked. macOS needs it to let RAVE LIVE hear what your Mac is playing; nothing is recorded.

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Please read the photosensitivity warning in the README before using strobes.
